board.title: Sidebar states
board.heading: Sidebar
board.intro: MainView.swift → Sidebar (with RecentQuestions and VaultSwitcher). One file, imported by every app window. Props: section, sub, queueCount, reviewCount, actionsCount, labelsCount, todoCount, slackCount, jiraCount, confluenceCount, recentRunning, recentFailed, recentOpen, vault, status, height. Swift’s Section has no Actions yet and no sub-items: both are design ahead of the app.

Swift: IconButton(systemImage:, size: = 26, tint: = Theme.muted, fill: Color? = nil, iconSize:, weight:, help:, label:, action:). board.heading: ActionsToolbar
board.intro: One toolbar for every Actions tab: [search] [Filter ▾ · N] [active filter chips] … [right slot]. Right slot: group/sort (To do), Newest first ▾ (Slack, History), connection status and Connect now (Jira, Confluence). No Swift view yet: add ActionsToolbar. board.title: Action row states
board.heading: ActionRow
board.intro: One row for every handler list (Slack messages, Jira tickets, Confluence pages) and History → Actions: type icon, title, source line, status pill. On hover: ✓ Complete (“you’ve handled it”, independent of Jira’s or Confluence’s own status) and ⋯; in History, Restore and ⋯. To do keeps its own row (a checkbox that completes, due date, person, labels and priority), because to-dos are worked through as a checklist. No Swift view yet: add ActionRow. Props: type, title, source, status, statusKind, selected, hover, mode (list | history), faded, width.
